📖 How to use

  1. Paste your tags, separated by commas or new lines.
  2. See the tag count and total characters vs YouTube's 500-character limit.
  3. Remove duplicates and over-long tags flagged in the table.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is YouTube's tag limit?

500 characters total across all tags. This tool sums the characters of your tags (commas excluded) and shows how much headroom remains.

How long can one tag be?

YouTube allows up to 30 words per tag in practice; very long single tags are flagged here at 60+ characters so you can split them.

Do tags still matter for ranking?

Less than they used to — title, description and watch time matter more. But accurate tags still help with misspellings and discovery.
